## MSI status

Microsatellite instability (MSI) is the result of impaired DNA mismatch repair and constitutes a cellular phenotype of clinical significance in many cancer types, most prominently colorectal, stomach, endometrial, and ovarian cancers [@Cortes-Ciriano2017-vl]. PCGR uses a statistical MSI classifier that only considers features of the somatic mutation profile (e.g. *fraction of indels*, *load of indels*, *mutations in MMR genes*) to separate *MSI-H* (MSI-high) from *MSS* (microsatellite stable) tumors. The classifier was trained on **N = 575** exome-sequenced TCGA tumor samples with known MSI status, with a positive predictive value of 97.9% and a negative predictive value of 99.3% on an independent test set (**N = 245** samples).

```{r msi_pdf_missing}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr isTRUE(pcg_report$content$msi$missing_data)
cat(pcgrr:::pdf_note(kind = "empty", 
  "Insufficient data for MSI prediction in this tumor sample.",
  title = "Not determined"))
```

```{r msi_pdf_setup}
#| echo: false
#| eval: !expr isFALSE(pcg_report$content$msi$missing_data)

msi_content_pdf <- pcg_report$content$msi$prediction
msi_stats_pdf <- msi_content_pdf$msi_stats

## core mismatch repair genes (as in the HTML report)
core_mmr_genes_pdf <- c("MLH1", "MSH2", "MSH6", "PMS2", "EPCAM")

prob_msi_h_pdf <- msi_stats_pdf[["prob_msi_h"]]
confidence_tier_pdf <- msi_stats_pdf[["confidence_tier"]]
is_msi_h_pdf <-
  msi_stats_pdf[["predicted_class"]] != "MSS (Microsatellite stable)"
uncertain_pdf <- isTRUE(confidence_tier_pdf == "Uncertain")
low_mut_pdf <- isTRUE(pcg_report$content$msi$low_mutation_warning)

## probability in the direction of the predicted class
prob_display_pdf <- if (is_msi_h_pdf) prob_msi_h_pdf else
  round(1 - prob_msi_h_pdf, 3)
prob_label_pdf <- if (is_msi_h_pdf) "Prediction probability P(MSI-H)" else
  "Prediction probability P(MSS)"

## somatic coding variants in the core MMR genes
snv_display_pdf <- pcg_report$content$snv_indel$callset$variant_display
mmr_somatic_pdf <- if (all(c("SYMBOL", "CODING_STATUS") %in%
                             colnames(snv_display_pdf))) {
  snv_display_pdf |>
    dplyr::filter(.data$CODING_STATUS == "coding" &
                    .data$SYMBOL %in% core_mmr_genes_pdf)
} else snv_display_pdf[0, , drop = FALSE]

## pathogenic/likely pathogenic germline variants in the core MMR genes
germline_eval_pdf <- isTRUE(pcg_report$content$germline_classified$eval)
mmr_germline_pdf <- data.frame()
if (germline_eval_pdf) {
  mmr_germline_pdf <-
    pcg_report$content$germline_classified$callset$variant_display |>
    dplyr::filter(
      .data$SYMBOL %in% core_mmr_genes_pdf &
        .data$CLINICAL_SIGNIFICANCE %in% c("Pathogenic", "Likely Pathogenic"))
}

msi_plot_caption_pdf <- paste0(
  "Somatic indel fraction (indels / all coding SNVs+indels) across the TCGA ",
  "reference cohort used to train the MSI classifier, by confirmed MSI ",
  "status (MSS: microsatellite stable; MSI-H: microsatellite ",
  "instability-high). The dotted line marks the indel fraction of this sample.")
```

```{r msi_pdf_warning}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr isFALSE(pcg_report$content$msi$missing_data) && (low_mut_pdf || uncertain_pdf)

warning_lines <- c()
if (low_mut_pdf) {
  sd_note <- if (!is.na(msi_stats_pdf[["frac_indels_expected_sd"]]))
    paste0(" (expected ±", msi_stats_pdf[["frac_indels_expected_sd"]],
           " at this mutation count)") else ""
  warning_lines <- c(warning_lines, paste0(
    "This sample has only **n = ", msi_stats_pdf[["n_calls"]],
    "** exonic variants after quality filtering, below the classifier ",
    "training threshold of n = 100. Feature estimates may be unstable",
    sd_note, "."))
}
if (uncertain_pdf) {
  warning_lines <- c(warning_lines, paste0(
    "The predicted probability P(MSI-H) = ", prob_msi_h_pdf,
    " falls in the uncertain range (0.10-0.90). Consider orthogonal MSI ",
    "assay confirmation."))
}
cat(pcgrr:::pdf_note(
  paste(warning_lines, collapse = "\n\n"),
  title = "Low-confidence MSI prediction", kind = "warning"))
```

```{r msi_pdf_kpis}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr isFALSE(pcg_report$content$msi$missing_data)

col_status <- if (uncertain_pdf) pcgrr::color_palette$warning else if
  (is_msi_h_pdf) pcgrr::color_palette$oncogenicity$values[1] else NULL
cat(pcgrr:::pdf_kpi_row(list(
  list(title = "MSI status",
       value = if (is_msi_h_pdf) "MSI-H" else "MSS",
       color = col_status),
  list(title = prob_label_pdf, value = as.character(prob_display_pdf),
       color = col_status),
  list(title = "Coding indel mutational burden",
       value = paste0(round(msi_stats_pdf[["tmb_indel"]], 2), " /Mb")))))
```

#| echo: false
